shapeSummary: Green PCB 31x1.6x23 mm with four 3.1 mm corner through-holes, a black relay block 20.5x15.3x16.5 mm in the middle, a blue 3-position terminal block (6.5x10x15 mm) on the +X edge, and a 5-pin 2.54 mm header on the -X edge with pins reaching Y=19 mm. Y is up, bottom at Y=0.
warnings: All dimensions are estimates; none were supplied.
Analysis bounds listed z=19 as height, but the Y-up rule was applied: X=31, Y=19 (height), Z=23.
Relay size taken from Omron G5LE datasheet approximation (20.5x16.5x15.3), not the analysis's 15.5x10.5x12.5.
Hole positions adjusted to clear the relay and terminal block.
Terminal screw slots, wire openings, relay markings, SMD parts, loose header pieces and jumper omitted.
cadquery:
def box(x,y,z,cx,cy,cz):
    return cq.Workplane('XY').box(x,y,z).translate((cx,cy,cz))

# PCB: 31 (X) x 1.6 (Y, up) x 23 (Z)
board = box(31,1.6,23,0,0.8,0)
holes = (cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(-13.5,-10),(-13.5,10),(13.5,-10),(13.5,10)])
         .circle(1.55).extrude(-5).translate((0,-1,0)))
board = board.cut(holes)

# Relay body (Omron G5LE style)
relay = box(20.5,15.3,16.5,-2.5,1.6+15.3/2,0)

# 3-position screw terminal block on +X edge
term = box(6.5,10,15,12.25,1.6+5,0)

# 5-pin header on -X edge: plastic base + square pins up to Y=19
hdr = box(2.54,2.5,12.7,-14.2,1.6+1.25,0)
for i in range(5):
    z = (i-2)*2.54
    hdr = hdr.union(box(0.64,19-1.6,0.64,-14.2,1.6+(19-1.6)/2,z))

part = board.union(relay).union(term).union(hdr)
